entities.name: SbcC nuclease subunit
observations: The 768-aa query has 100% identity and full query coverage to reviewed Staphylococcus haemolyticus SbcCD subunit C reference Q4L655; reference target coverage is 76%.
The query has a Pfam AAA_23 domain (PF13476.13) at residues 5–215.
Reference SbcC annotations describe SbcCD as a heterodimer that cleaves DNA hairpins and has 3′→5′ double-strand exonuclease activity; this function is homology-based for the query.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 90.7 kDa, pI 5.38, GRAVY −0.94.
